Starter Roster — Sprite Sheets

Five fighters built to the platform-fighter character spec: idle, walk, run, jump, fall, landing, dash/dodge/roll, three taunts, full ground tilt set, five aerials, three smash attacks, four specials and three palette swaps each — plus a shared effects library (slash arcs, impact sparks, dust/smoke, misc FX).

Each sheet mirrors the reference layout for Valor the Swordsman, so frames can be sliced from matching rows across characters.

5 fighters · 6 palettes each · shared move vocabulary · black-keyed for additive blending
01

VALOR

THE SWORDSMAN

All-Rounder / Swordfighter

Balanced bladesman with disjointed reach. The beginner-friendly baseline template every other fighter is measured against — the Ryu/Mario of the roster.

WeightMedium
Jumps2
MovementAverage
RangeLong (blade)

SPECIAL MOVES

  • Neutral — Lunar Slash
  • Side — Rush Strike
  • Up — Skyward Ascent
  • Down — Guardian Stance

02

GRIM

THE COLOSSUS

Heavyweight / Power

A walking tectonic event. Enormous per-hit knockback, huge hurtbox and high gravity — combos hard, kills early, recovers poorly. Pure risk-and-reward.

WeightVery Heavy
Jumps2
MovementSlow
RangeShort (fists)

SPECIAL MOVES

  • Neutral — Magma Fist
  • Side — Rush Strike
  • Up — Skyward Ascent
  • Down — Guardian Stance
Full-resolution source: roster/grim_the_colossus_spritesheet.png · 1264×848 px
03

ASTRA

THE STARWEAVER

Floaty / Zoner

Low gravity, slow fall, long staff. Dictates the pace with crescent-arc magic at mid range and a teleport-based recovery that makes her hard to edgeguard.

WeightLight
Jumps3
MovementSlow air drift
RangeMid (staff/magic)

SPECIAL MOVES

  • Neutral — Shooting Star Bolt
  • Side — Comet Rush
  • Up — Star Blink
  • Down — Gravity Orb
Full-resolution source: roster/astra_the_starweaver_spritesheet.png · 1264×848 px

VESPER

THE SHADE

Lightweight / Rushdown

Fastest fighter in the cast. Dies early and hits softly, but her frame data and shadow-step mixups let her open shields and chase tech rolls relentlessly.

WeightVery Light
Jumps2
MovementVery Fast
RangeShort-mid (daggers)

SPECIAL MOVES

  • Neutral — Kunai Barrage
  • Side — Shadowstep Dash
  • Up — Viper Ascendant
  • Down — Smoke Counter
Full-resolution source: roster/vesper_the_shade_spritesheet.png · 1264×848 px
05

ROOK

THE HEXSHOT

Zoner / Projectile

Controls space with hex-bullet volleys and rune mines. Weak up close — his whole game is about keeping you at the exact distance where his rifle is loaded.

WeightMedium-Light
Jumps2
MovementAverage
RangeLong (rifle)

SPECIAL MOVES

  • Neutral — Hex Bullet Volley
  • Side — Rune Lasso / Ricochet
  • Up — Rune-Drone Grapple
  • Down — Rune Mine Trap

Sheets are concept/design deliverables: the art is AI-generated and intended as a visual target for a sprite artist or a basis for slice-and-rig pipelines — hand-authored pixel art or 3D-to-2D renders are recommended for a production build. Palette rows, effect rows and per-attack naming follow the GDD's per-character requirements (§10.4).
